title: School Management System
tagline: One platform to run every side of a school — students, staff, and attendance, live.
description: A full school management platform covering teacher and student records, attendance, exams, and grading — accessible from a web dashboard and a companion mobile app.
overview: A full school management platform covering teacher and student records, attendance, exams, and grading — accessible from both a web dashboard and a companion mobile app.
problem: Schools often track attendance, marks, and reporting across scattered spreadsheets and paper registers, making real-time visibility and report generation slow and error-prone.
solution: We built a unified system where teachers mark live attendance from their phone or the web dashboard, exam marks and grades are recorded once and rolled into report cards automatically, and admins get a real-time view across the whole school.
features: Live attendance tracking from web and mobile
Web dashboard for admins, mobile app for teachers

title: DotPOS
tagline: Point-of-sale software built for everyday retail.
description: A point-of-sale system for retail businesses — handling sales, billing, and day-to-day store operations.
overview: A point-of-sale system for retail businesses — handling sales, billing, and day-to-day store operations.
problem: Small and mid-size retailers need reliable, easy-to-use point-of-sale software without the overhead of enterprise POS suites.
solution: DotPOS gives retailers a straightforward system for processing sales and running daily store operations.

title: AGRO — Insect Identification App
tagline: Point your camera, know the insect.
description: A mobile app that uses computer vision to identify insects from a photo, helping farmers and growers recognise pests in the field.
overview: A mobile app that uses computer vision to identify insects from a photo, aimed at helping farmers and growers recognise pests in the field.
problem: Farmers need to quickly identify insects on their crops to decide whether they're dealing with a pest or a beneficial species — without waiting for an expert.
solution: The app uses a vision AI model to identify insect species from a photo taken directly in the field, right from a phone.
features: Built for agricultural use in the field

title: EdgeCam
tagline: Stream your phone as a security camera, anywhere on your network.
description: A mobile app that turns your phone into a live streaming security camera over your local network — for home or office surveillance.
overview: A mobile app that turns your phone into a live streaming security camera over your local network — for home or office surveillance.
problem: Setting up dedicated home security cameras is often expensive or complicated, when spare phones could do the job.
solution: EdgeCam streams live video from a phone's camera over the local network, so any spare device can become a security camera.
features: Live camera streaming over local network
Turns any phone into a surveillance camera

title: EasyWatch
tagline: AI-powered CCTV monitoring that actually watches for you.
description: An AI-powered security surveillance system for homes, offices, and CCTV setups — built to actively watch footage instead of just recording it.
overview: An AI-powered security surveillance system for homes, offices, and CCTV setups — built to actively watch footage instead of just recording it.
problem: Traditional CCTV just records — someone still has to watch the footage to catch anything useful.
solution: EasyWatch applies vision AI to CCTV feeds to actively monitor for security events across homes and offices.
features: Works with home, office & CCTV setups

title: Dot-CLI
tagline: An AI CLI agent that plugs into any LLM and gets things done.
description: An open-source AI command-line agent, forked from OpenCode, capable of connecting to any custom LLM provider and running automated tasks.
overview: An open-source AI command-line agent, forked from OpenCode, capable of connecting to any custom LLM provider and running automated tasks.
problem: Teams want an AI coding/automation agent they can point at their own LLM provider — not locked to one vendor.
solution: Dot-CLI connects to any custom LLM provider and runs automated tasks from the command line, built as an open-source fork of OpenCode.
features: Connects to any custom LLM provider

title: DotForms
tagline: Turn a stack of handwritten forms into structured data — fast.
description: A handwritten form extraction system using OCR and LLMs, able to extract data from any form type and push it into other systems for processing.
overview: A handwritten form extraction system using OCR and LLMs, able to extract data from any form type and connect it to other systems for processing.
problem: Digitising handwritten forms by hand is slow — manually re-typing thousands of forms takes days.
solution: DotForms combines OCR and LLMs to extract structured data from any handwritten form, at up to 100 forms a minute, and connects that data to downstream systems automatically.
features: OCR + LLM based handwritten form extraction
Up to 100 forms processed per minute
Digitise around 1,000 forms in a day
Connects extracted data to other systems
